messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello, honey, it's Gloria Hart. The pharmacy said Dr. Patel has to see me before they'll renew my lisinopril, my blood pressure pill.
AGENT (LATEST): Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Family Medicine. I can help you get that set up. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks again why she is calling or which medication, after she already said
move_1: the agent offers appointment times
move_2: the agent first reads back the appointment
asked_1: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "DOB 1947-05-12"
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "About a week of lisinopril left"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Wants the soonest appointment"
stop_0: Agent confirms a Dr. Patel appointment she understood.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not re-ask reason or medication."}, "move_1": {"met": false, "why": "No appointment times offered yet."}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "No appointment read back yet."}, "asked_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks for date of birth."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about medication supply."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about appointment timing preference."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No appointment confirmed yet."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency."}}
